items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Critical Remote Code Execution in Amasty Extensions
items.summary: Sansec reported a critical vulnerability in 25 Amasty Magento extensions, with one leading to remote code execution. Sansec Shield already blocks the critical issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: This vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution. It affects Amasty Order Attributes.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Commerce allows remote, unauthenticated attackers to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access. Exploitation requires no user interaction.

items.title: PolyShell: Unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store by disguising code as an image. Attacks have been observed on a significant percentage of stores, with a fix released in Magento 2.4.9 in May 2026.

items.title: Critical Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security controls, gain escalated privileges, execute unauthorized malicious code, and compromise customer accounts. Adobe recommends immediate patching.
